QUESTION: Does ANY requirement doc in this repo confirm the DISPLAY FORMAT for customer-group / promotion pricing in the cart and order summary? Specifically I need to know whether anything confirms:

(A) A basket-summary discount line format that is JUST "{promotion name} Applied" + amount, with NO discount PERCENTAGE. (A PR claims its flat, no-percentage format "matches the confirmed AC" — I need to find whether that confirmation exists in the repo at all.)
(B) Whether any doc specifies the discount line should include the percentage (e.g. "VIP Preview Summer 26 (20% off) — -$80").
(C) An item-level / per-cart-line promotional label beneath a cart item (e.g. "20% off applied", "Private Sale — 20% Off Applied").
(D) Whether a Remove action should or should not appear on a basket-summary discount line.

SEARCH SCOPE — be exhaustive and report exactly what you searched:
1. `ls -R .docs/` (full tree listing, so I can quote the doc set).
2. Read any of these that exist, fully or the relevant sections: `.docs/prd/*.md` (especially anything named pricing, promotions, cart, checkout, customer-group, giftcards, regional, plp, pdp), `.docs/integration/*.md`, `.docs/memory/*.md` (projectState.md, sprintScope.md), `.docs/architecture.md`.
3. Grep widely, case-insensitive, across `.docs/`, `.claude/`, and repo-root `*.md`:
   - `grep -rn -i -E 'customer group|customer-group|price rule|catalogue price|catalog price|VIC|VIP|member discount|group discount' .docs .claude *.md`
   - `grep -rn -i -E 'was/now|was\b.*now|% off|percent off|off applied|promotion name|priceAdjustment|discount line|order summary' .docs .claude *.md`
   - `grep -rn -i -E 'SFCC-645|SFCC-778|SFCC-194|SFCC-38' . --include=*.md`
4. Also check `.claude/session-notes.md` and `.claude/registry/*.md` if they exist.
5. Check whether a Figma reference or Confluence link in the docs is cited as the source of truth for the cart discount line format.

Report:
(a) For each of A/B/C/D: does a confirmation exist? If yes, quote it with `file:line`. If no, say so plainly.
(b) The explicit list of directories/files/greps you ran, so I can state the search scope verbatim in a review finding.
(c) Note any doc that discusses promotions in cart at all, even if it doesn't settle the format — I want to know if the topic is simply absent vs. present-but-silent on format.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'inspect' returns the accessibility tree of the front app (what a screen reader reads, which can differ from what is drawn) as JSON — per element: type, label, value, frame [x,y,width,height] in device points from the top-left, traits the type does not imply, enabled only when false, children. Call 'inspect' before a 'tap' on anything you have not located in this screen's tree, before answering what text a screen shows, and before reporting a control's state (a switch's value, whether a button is enabled, which tab is selected) or whether a sheet, alert or other modal is in front (the result says so) — never guess coordinates from memory of similar apps, and do not 'screenshot' for these. Go straight to 'screenshot' for color, images, and layout.      1	# PRD – Promotions Engine
     2	
     3	*Source of truth: Zimmermann Functional Requirements.xlsx, sheet "Price, Currency, Promo" (PRC). Last updated: 2026-06-25.*
     4	
     5	This PRD covers the SFCC promotions engine — coupon codes, stacking rules, scheduling, and display. Price feeds, display & tax, sale/markdown, multi-currency & FX, VIC/customer-group pricing, and Global-e pricing & cart handoff live in [pricing-currency-globale.md](pricing-currency-globale.md).

PRC-13 (AP21 catalogue markdowns + SFCC promotions in order payload) signed off by Emma/Rebecca (2026-06-24). Customer-group discount exclusion on sale items (PRC-18) is also documented in the pricing PRD where the VIC discount rules live.*
     8	
     9	---
    10	
    11	## 1. Promotions Engine (PRC-20 – PRC-32)
    12	
    13	- All promotions configured in SFCC Business Manager via the native Campaigns and Promotions module (PRC-20)
    14	- Promotion scoping: storefront (one, several, or all), customer group, product/category, spend threshold. Note (DR): ability to easily exclude "Sale" / "Special Price" products (as configured in M2 today) is required (PRC-21)
    15	- Coupon code generation: single-use unique codes and generic multi-use codes; bulk import via CSV (PRC-22). Note: ~8 active promos in Magento must be migrated to SFCC at go-live.
    16	- **Maximum 1 promo code per cart** (PRC-23)
    17	- Configurable maximum redemptions per promotion and per customer (PRC-24)
    18	- Promotion scheduling with start and end dates/times, including time-zone awareness per storefront (PRC-25)
    19	- CS one-off promotion codes (credit notes, shipping corrections) via backend Business Manager — confirmed with Cayley in CS. Note (RJ): an audit / tracking ability on these codes is required (PRC-26, confirmed — signed off by Dani + Emma)
    20	- **Promotion stacking rules:** product, order, and shipping promotion types stack with each other; within the same type, only the highest discount applies. Sale items are excluded from promotion set-ups — customer group discounts do not stack on sale-priced items (PRC-18, revised per DR)
    21	- Auto-applied promotions (free shipping, customer group discounts) applied silently without code entry (PRC-30)
    22	- **Free shipping threshold** evaluated on the post-discount cart total — a promotion discount can reduce an order below the free shipping threshold (PRC-31)
    23	- **Retail Rewards applied after promotion calculation** (PRC-32)
    24	- Promotions displayed at line-item and/or order level in: mini-bag, cart, checkout, and order history (PRC-27)
    25	- Applied promotion info passed to NewStore via MuleSoft at order placement (PRC-28)
    26	- Cart/Bag page shows active promotion details: banner confirming promotion applied and inline code entry with validation feedback (valid / invalid / expired / already redeemed) (PRC-29)
    27	
    28	---
    29

    31	
    32	*(Confirmed 2026-06-24 — signed off Emma, Rebecca)*
    33	
    34	The system supports both AP21 catalogue price markdowns and SFCC-configured promotions. The combined discount breakdown must be reflected in the order placement payload for accounting and ERP reporting purposes.
    35	
    36	**Discount taxonomy included in the order payload:**
    37	
    38	- **Total Discount** — the combination of catalogue price discount, cart price discount, and pricebook discount
    39	- **Markdown flag** (yes/no) — based on whether a total discount is present
    40	- **Perm** — permanent pricebook change sourced from AP21 (e.g. end-of-season clearance priced in the pricebook)
    41	- **Temp** — not in use
    42	
    43	**PWA scope:**
    44	
    45	- The storefront must display the correct sale/markdown price per the AP21 `MarkdownStatus` field (display behaviour is detailed in [pricing-currency-globale.md](pricing-currency-globale.md))
    46	- The order placement payload sent to NewStore/MuleSoft must include the discount taxonomy above
    47	
    48	The payload field specification and ERP reporting format are out-of-PWA-boundary concerns — these are to be resolved in the MuleSoft integration design session.
    49	
    50	*Cross-reference: AP21 markdown pricing and `MarkdownStatus` display behaviour are also tracked in [pricing-currency-globale.md](pricing-currency-globale.md). The order-payload and SFCC promotions angle is owned by this PRD.*

400	  explicit reason for bundling. Consequence to accept: the ACs can't be signed off independently and

**(A) Flat "{promotion name} Applied" + amount, no percentage, in the basket summary — NO CONFIRMATION EXISTS.**

Nothing in `.docs/` or `.claude/` specifies that format, or any basket-summary discount line format at all. The claim "matches the confirmed AC" is not supported by anything in the repo. Worse, the only design-derived spec for that exact component contradicts the existence of such a line:

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.claude/session-notes.md:802-808`
```

Five enumerated rows at fixed y-offsets, no discount row. The only promotion element in the totals summary is the "ADD PROMOTION CODE" accordion, and it is explicitly assigned to **SFCC-191, Squad B** — not this bundle (`.claude/session-notes.md:648-649`, `:669-677`: *"Do not absorb these six groups into the cart bundle — they belong to other cards and other squads."*).

Also directly relevant, and arguably against a summary discount line for customer-group pricing at all — `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/prd/pricing-currency-globale.md:63`:
```
Customer-group-specific catalogue pricing — visible on PLP, PDP, mini-bag, cart, checkout,
recommended tiles, wishlist (not cart-only discounts). Discounts do not apply to products
already on sale or to gift cards.
```
Customer-group pricing is specified as **catalogue** pricing (i.e. it shows in the item price / was-now), with the parenthetical explicitly excluding cart-only discounts.

**(B) Percentage in the discount line — NO direct confirmation for a basket-summary line, but the only two specced discount-label formats in the repo BOTH include the percentage.**

1. `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/prd/checkout.md:211` (PAY-028, Confirmed/signed-off sheet):
```

```
Caveat you must carry: this sits in checkout.md §12 **Retail Rewards**, and `checkout.md:215` (PAY-032) says *"Retail Rewards are a voucher payment method, not a discount."* So it is an adjacent house precedent for how Zimmermann words a named summary deduction line (group name + percentage + amount), not a direct AC for promotion pricing.

Net: no doc mandates a percentage on a basket-summary line, but no doc sanctions omitting it either, and every worked example in the repo carries one.

**(C) Item-level / per-cart-line promotional label — YES, THIS IS THE ONE THING CONFIRMED, and it carries a percentage.**
